# Central

> Named periodic tasks on one Heartbeat connection: Register, Pause, Resume, Cancel (Gaxia.Central).

- Package: `Central` · Category: Shared utilities
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: nothing else (only Core)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Central")` on the server; `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Central")` on the client

## `Gaxia.Central`

- Runs: **server and client**
- Source: `src/ReplicatedStorage/Gaxia_Packages/Shared/CentralManager.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local Gaxia = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages)
local Central = Gaxia.Central
-- or, to get its types in your own ModuleScript: local CentralManager = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages.Shared.CentralManager)
```

### Functions

- `CentralManager.Register(self: InternalCentralManager, options: TaskOptions, callback: Callback): TaskHandle`
  Runs `callback(elapsed)` every `options.intervalSec` seconds (every frame when 0) from `startTime` until `endTime`, lowest `priority` first. Returns a handle.
- `CentralManager.Cancel(self: InternalCentralManager, name: string): boolean`
  Cancels task `name` (fires Canceled). False when no such task.
- `CentralManager.Pause(self: InternalCentralManager, name: string): boolean`
  Pauses task `name` (fires Paused). False when absent or already paused.
- `CentralManager.Resume(self: InternalCentralManager, name: string): boolean`
  Resumes task `name` (fires Resumed). False when absent or not paused.
- `CentralManager.Destroy(self: InternalCentralManager): ()`
  Cancels every task and destroys the signals; Register errors afterwards.
